articles.title: Four Wynn Restaurants Recognized in the Trip.Gourmet 2027 Global Fine Dining Awards
articles.summary: Macao, September 9, 2026 – Four of Wynn's signature restaurants have been honored at Trip.Gourmet's 10th Anniversary Edition: Global Restaurant Rankings and Fine Dining Awards Ceremony held in Singapore on September 8. Chef Tam's Seasons received the highest honor of "Black Diamond" award, while Mizumi, Wing Lei and Drunken Fish were each honored with the prestigious "Platinum" award.

articles.title: Five SJM Restaurants Are Honoured at Trip.Gourmet’s 10th Anniversary Awards
articles.summary: (Macau, 8 September 2026) Robuchon au Dôme of SJM Resorts has retained Trip.Gourmet's highest Black Diamond rating for the fourth consecutive year, one of five SJM restaurants honoured at the 10th Anniversary Awards. Palace Garden and The Eight received Diamond ratings, and Don Alfonso 1890 and Mesa by José Avillez received Platinum.

articles.title: SJM Hosts Fortune Leaders Forums Macau Debut at GLP
articles.summary: (Macau, 9 September 2026) SJM Resorts served as host partner and venue supporter of the Fortune Leaders Forum 2026 at Grand Lisboa Palace Resort Macau, the forum's Macau debut. More than 250 senior executives, policymakers and investors gathered, including C-suite leaders of Fortune Global 500, Fortune Southeast Asia 500 and Fortune China 500 companies.

articles.title: Three MGM Restaurants Recognized in Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Global Fine Dining Selection
articles.summary: [September 8, 2026, Macau] Three of MGM's signature dining restaurants have been listed on the Trip.Gourmet 2027 Global Fine Dining Selection. Aji makes its debut as a Platinum Restaurant, while returning honorees Five Foot Road and Imperial Court have been recognized as Diamond Restaurant and Platinum Restaurant, respectively.

articles.title: Sands China Hosts ‘The Parisian Macao 10th Anniversary Community Fun Day’
articles.rawDate: Sep.6 Sands China Hosts ‘The Parisian Macao 10th Anniversary Community Fun Day’
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 6, 2026) – To celebrate the 10th anniversary of The Parisian Macao, Sands China hosted The Parisian Macao 10th Anniversary Community Fun Day on Sept. 5, welcoming 130 participants including family members from local social service organisations and Sands Cares Ambassadors.

articles.title: MGM Donates MOP5 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang
articles.summary: [September 4, 2026, Macau] MGM China Holdings Limited announced a donation of MOP5 million to the Xizang Autonomous Region, with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macau SAR, to support emergency relief and post-disaster recovery in Gyirong County, Xigaze.

articles.title: Sands China Donates MOP 10 Million in Support of Xizang Mudslide Relief Efforts
articles.rawDate: Sep.4 Sands China Donates MOP 10 Million in Support of Xizang Mudslide Relief Efforts
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 4, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. announced a donation of MOP 10 million to support relief efforts in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region, following a devastating mudslide. The donation will be made with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao SAR.

articles.title: SJM Donates MOP 5 Million to Support Disaster Relief and Reconstruction Efforts in Gyirong County
articles.summary: (Macau, 4 September 2026) SJM Resorts has donated MOP 5 million through the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao SAR to support emergency rescue, resettlement and post-disaster reconstruction in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet Autonomous Region.

articles.title: Wynn Donates MOP5 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Gyirong, Xizang
articles.summary: Macao, September 4, 2026 – Wynn Macau, Limited announced a donation of MOP5 million to support emergency relief and post-disaster recovery efforts in Gyirong County, Xigaze City, Xizang Autonomous Region, with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao SAR.

articles.title: GEG and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation Donate MOP10 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Xizang
articles.summary: September 3, 2026 – Galaxy Entertainment Group and Lui Che Woo Family Charitable Foundation will jointly donate MOP10 million, with the assistance of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macau SAR, to support emergency relief and post-disaster recovery in Gyirong County, Xigaze, Xizang Autonomous Region.

articles.title: Sands China Receives Two MICE Honours at M&C Asia Stella Awards 2026
articles.rawDate: Sep.3 Sands China Receives Two MICE Honours at M&C Asia Stella Awards 2026
articles.summary: (Macao, September 3, 2026) – Sands China Ltd. has won two major awards at the M&C Asia Stella Awards 2026, with Sands Resorts Macao retaining Best Integrated Resort (MICE) and The Venetian Macao winning Best Meetings Hotel (Macao).

articles.title: Wynn Launches 20th Anniversary Share Award for Team Members
articles.summary: Macao, September 3, 2026 – As this year marks the company's 20th anniversary in Macao, Wynn Macau, Limited announced a one-time "Wynn Macau 20th Anniversary Share Award", under which eligible team members of Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace will be granted shares in Wynn Macau, Limited.

articles.title: ‘Sands Cares in the Greater Bay Area: The Macao and Hengqin Study Tour for Youth 2026’
articles.rawDate: Sep.2 ‘Sands Cares in the Greater Bay Area: The Macao and Hengqin Study Tour for Youth 2026’
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 2, 2026) – Sands China and the Macau Youth Development Service Centre co-organised 'Sands Cares in the Greater Bay Area: The Macao and Hengqin Study Tour 2026' on Sept. 2, taking Macao university social-work students and Sands Cares Ambassadors to the Guangdong-Macao In-Depth Cooperation Zone in Hengqin.

articles.title: Wynn Palace Becomes the First in Macao to Debut on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 Extended 51-100 List
articles.summary: Macao, September 2, 2026 – Wynn Palace has been named No.96 on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 extended 51–100 list, becoming the first hotel in Macao to be recognized in the prestigious global award. The accolade recognizes Wynn Palace's commitment to bespoke hospitality, world-class gastronomy and resort experiences.

articles.title: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong Recognized in the World’s 50 Best Hotels 2026 Extended List
articles.summary: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong has once again been recognized in the extended ranking of The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026, placing at No. 86.
